title: 10th Sitting of First session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/10/1/2026).
Preliminary debate on the Bill to amend the Maldives Fisheries Act (Law No. 14/2019), submitted on behalf of the government by South Thinadhoo MP Mohamed Alsan Ahmed.
Report of the Privileges and Ethics Committee on the privileges matter raised by North Galolhu MP Mohamed Ibrahim under Article 208 of the Standing Orders of the Majlis.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to debate a government bill amending the Fisheries Act and to take up a committee report on a privileges complaint by MP Mohamed Ibrahim.
